about: South Carolina Division of Procurement Services, 'Agreed Upon Procedures - Agency Purchasing Card Program', revised July 1, 2025: the steps every state agency's annual P-Card auditor runs, each saying what to obtain or request from the agency. Pages 5-7 (the nine numbered steps), copied unchanged; the cover, proviso text and exhibits are left out. Not a PBC list an auditor sent, but the closest public card-program request we found. The audit period is a placeholder ('[Audit Period Begin] to [Audit Period End]'), so periods are null. Steps have sub-items (3 a-m are fields of one listing, 6 i-v and 8 i-ii are tests on one population) that are part of their step, not separate requests. Ramp-answerable: 8 (scan the card population for blocked merchant categories and over-limit transactions: control_testing) and 9 (sample of 25 card transactions, request receipts: transaction_support, no selections listed yet). Judgment calls: 3 (listing of all card transactions for two statements, with approver and MCC) and 6 (listing of active cards with limits and last use) are data Ramp holds, but Tickmark has no listing type for them, so they are unsupported; this is a product gap, not a parser miss. 4 reviews the written P-Card manual, including separation of duties between cardholder and approver: a document review, scored unsupported. 7 asks for the blocked MCC list (configuration, unsupported). 6's threshold is the $2,500 single transaction limit that needs extra approval ($10,000 is the second tier).
